compliance: Telehealth consultations must follow the professional's licensing rules and local telehealth regulations [CONFIRM: applicable Abu Dhabi / UAE telehealth standard]. GeneBridge verifies licences but professionals are responsible for their clinical practice.

trust.title: Trust & safety
trust.subtitle: How GeneBridge keeps counselling safe and private.

verified.title: Only verified professionals
verified.body: Every professional's licence is checked by a GeneBridge admin before they can appear in the directory, receive messages or be booked. If a licence expires or is suspended, they lose access straight away.

chat.title: Your messages stay between you two
chat.body: Messages with a professional are read only by you and them. They are never read by AI, never used for analytics, and an admin sees a single message only if one of you reports it, and every view is recorded.

sharing.title: You decide what to share
sharing.body: Messaging or booking a professional shares nothing about your results. You choose what to share, and you can stop sharing at any time in Privacy & consent.

calendar.title: No health information in calendars
calendar.body: Calendar events are titled "GeneBridge session" and contain only a link back to GeneBridge. No condition, result or health detail is ever added.

summaries.title: Summaries from your counsellor
summaries.subtitle: Written after your session, in plain words. Only you and your counsellor can see them.
